newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia June 1-15 palm oil exports 290,935t-SGS.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia June 1-15 palm oil exports 290,935t-SGS.

text.p: Cargo surveyor Societe Generale de Surveillance (SGS) Malaysia Sdn Bhd said on Monday it estimated Malaysia's palm oil exports for June 1-15 at 290,935 tonnes against 264,659 tonnes for May 1-15.
It said the exports comprised 76,815 tonnes of RBD palm oil, 118,206 of RBD palm olein and 42,109 tonnes of RBD palm stearin. The other products totalled 53,805 tonnes.
China was the top buyer during the period, taking 58,300 tonnes, followed by India which bought 38,280 tonnes, Pakistan (33,200 tonnes) and South Africa (20,950 tonnes).
Countries in the European Union bought 30,958 tonnes. -- Tan Lee Lee - Kuala Lumpur newsroom (603-275-6834)
